scenes.description: Hero title 'OPENAI o3-PRO' with subtitle 'KỶ NGUYÊN AI BIẾT SUY NGHĨ'. Dark slate background, slow-rotating neural lattice, warm amber accent glow behind title.
scenes.movement: lattice nodes fade in and drift, title letters rise with stagger, subtitle wipes in beneath
scenes.shot_intent: Establish o3-Pro as a generational shift, not an increment
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: o3-Pro launched, marks reasoning-AI era

scenes.description: Side-by-side comparison. Left column 'MÔ HÌNH CŨ': straight arrow prompt -> answer, fast. Right column 'o3-PRO': prompt enters a thinking loop (self-check, revise) before answer.
scenes.framing: two vertical columns, divider line down center
scenes.movement: left arrow shoots across instantly; right path circulates the loop 3 times with checkmarks appearing, then releases to answer
scenes.transition_out: loop collapses into a score badge
scenes.overlay_notes: Loop label 'Test-Time Compute'; small counter 'suy nghĩ… 1/2/3'
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: o3-Pro thinks, self-checks, and corrects before answering

scenes.description: Vertical bar chart on GPQA. Bars for 'GPT-4o' and 'o3-Pro'; o3-Pro bar grows to 87.7% and locks with an amber highlight ring.
scenes.framing: chart occupies center 65% height, headline 'GPQA — TRÌNH ĐỘ TIẾN SĨ' above
scenes.movement: bars grow bottom-up with easing, percentage numbers count up, record ring pulses once on lock
scenes.overlay_notes: Value label '87.7%' large; caption 'điểm số kỷ lục'
scenes.shot_intent: Land the benchmark result as the proof point
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: 87.7% GPQA, solves problems GPT-4o cannot

scenes.description: 2x2 grid of enterprise task cards escalating in complexity: 'Viết email', 'Tóm tắt văn bản' (dimmed, labeled cũ) vs 'Phân tích dữ liệu', 'Kiến trúc phần mềm' (lit, labeled o3-Pro).
scenes.framing: 2x2 grid, top row dimmed, bottom row highlighted
scenes.movement: top cards slide in and dim; bottom cards slide in and ignite with connecting lines to a central 'DOANH NGHIỆP' node
scenes.transition_in: chart bars fan out into cards
scenes.transition_out: grid tilts back to reveal cost gauge
scenes.overlay_notes: Arrow from top row to bottom row labeled 'nâng cấp vai trò'
scenes.shot_intent: Translate benchmark gain into business capability
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: o3-Pro handles analysis and architecture work, not just drafting

scenes.description: Two gauges rising in parallel: 'CHI PHÍ API' and 'ĐỘ TRỄ PHẢN HỒI', both climbing into an amber caution zone while a compute meter fills behind them.
scenes.framing: two vertical gauges side by side, compute meter as background band
scenes.movement: gauges sweep upward with needle overshoot, caution band pulses, compute meter fills left to right
scenes.transition_out: gauges split apart to open routing diagram
scenes.overlay_notes: Caption 'nhiều tài nguyên tính toán hơn / mỗi câu hỏi'
scenes.shot_intent: State the trade-off honestly before the recommendation
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: higher API cost and higher latency per query

scenes.description: Router diagram. Incoming request stream hits a decision node that splits: routine volume -> 'GPT-4o' lane, strategic queries -> 'o3-Pro' lane. Lane widths reflect volume.
scenes.framing: left-to-right flow rotated to fit vertical frame, router node centered
scenes.movement: request dots flow in, router pulses on each split decision, thin o3-Pro lane glows when a strategic dot routes through
scenes.transition_out: lanes converge upward into closing title
scenes.overlay_notes: Header 'MÔ HÌNH LAI'; lane labels 'tác vụ hàng ngày' and 'bài toán chiến lược'
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: route by task value — hybrid GPT-4o + o3-Pro

scenes.description: Closing card 'KỶ NGUYÊN AI SUY LUẬN ĐÃ BẮT ĐẦU' with OpenMontage wordmark and subscribe prompt. Neural lattice returns, fully lit.
scenes.framing: centered text stack, wordmark lower third
scenes.movement: lattice brightens, headline fades up, wordmark and subscribe cue settle last
scenes.shot_intent: Close with forward-looking tone and channel CTA
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns: era has started, follow OpenMontage
